country.evidence_quote: Text HOME to 741741 from anywhere in the United States – 24/7, free, confidential. Crisis Text Line is here for you. A live, trained volunteer Crisis Counselor will receive your text and respond with care and compassion. They’re here to listen, support you, and help you move from a hot moment to a cool calm.

external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The UBS Optimus Foundation is fueling the growth of Crisis Text Line’s volunteer community, ensuring more people in distress can connect to compassionate, 24/7 mental health support.

American Eagle is championing youth mental health through its partnership with Crisis Text Line, empowering young people to access care and advocate for change. As a sponsor of Crisis Text Line’s Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) Mental Health Program, American Eagle has enabled the creation of individualized, co-branded text lines across six HBCUs, ensuring students can reach out for support in moments of need.

TikTok takes a proactive approach to digital well-being by embedding mental health support directly into its platform. The prompt "Text TIKTOK to 741741” is featured across reporting tools and in-app support resources, connecting people to care when they need it most.

Nike is leading the conversation around mental health and resilience through the power of sport and storytelling. In collaboration with Crisis Text Line, Nike launched a podcast series hosted by Crisis Text Line’s Chief Health Officer, Dr. Shairi Turner, MPH, and Global Expansion Director, Natalia Dayan, LMSW, featuring inspiring athletes such as Karl Anthony-Towns, Laurie Hernandez, and Olympian Raven Saunders.

With the support of Face the Fight, a national initiative led by USAA, Reach Resilience, and the Humana Foundation to prevent veteran suicide, Crisis Text Line is expanding access to mental health support for veterans, active-duty service members, and military families. Through the custom keyword and message “Text SERVICE or SERVICIO to 741741,” Face the Fight connects members of the military community to 24/7, confidential support.

MLB is helping to increase mental health awareness and support by partnering with Crisis Text Line. The message “Text MLB to 741741” is prominently displayed in stadiums and featured in broadcast graphics, amplifying access to mental health resources nationwide. MLB additionally extends this initiative to the next generation through mental health workshops benefiting youth and their families, further expanding the reach of critical mental health support across all levels of the game.
Through Microsoft Xbox’s powerful “Never Fight Alone” campaign, Gears of War is making a lasting impact on mental health awareness and suicide prevention in the gaming community.
–Lorez Meinhold, Caring for Denver Foundation’s Executive Director

In partnership with The Defensive Line, an organization dedicated to ending the epidemic of youth suicide, especially among young people of color, Crisis Text Line joined forces with the American Foundation for Suicide Prevention (AFSP) and the Faith Fight Finish Foundation during Suicide Prevention Month.

We partner with the National Alliance for Eating Disorders to provide the co-branded keyword ALLIANCE, which connects their community to free, 24/7 mental health support via text. Beyond the keyword, this organization's leaders serve as a trusted subject matter expert on eating disorders for our organization, lending their expertise to guide the tip sheets and resources we provide to texters reaching out about these issues.

Our partnership with Live Free 999 centers on the keyword LF999, which helps us reach and support Black men and BIPOC communities seeking mental health support, and has grown to include co-collaboration on media opportunities and social media posts that extend our shared message.

network.stated_total_quote: We partner with more than 100 nonprofit organizations to bring our vital, free support directly into communities nationwide. Together, we expand access to care while sharing insights that help partners better understand and respond to mental health needs. In return, these collaborations help us reach more people in moments of emotional crisis.
